svg.title: When Excel numbers are stored as text: green-triangle conversion and the VALUE function
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
When Excel numbers are stored as text: green-triangle
conversion and the VALUE function
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-08
Check the green triangle in the
upper-left corner of the cell
Excel detects most numbers stored as text and
displays a green triangle in the upper-left
corner of the cell.
When the error indicator button is
unavailable
If the button is not visible, go to File >
Options > Formulas and check whether 'Enable
background error checking' is turned on.
Create a helper column with the VALUE
function
In an empty column next to the original, enter a
formula such as =VALUE(E23) that references the
text cell, then fill it down.
What to check after conversion
① Check whether the SUM result in the total cell
is the expected value. ② Confirm that the
alignment has changed to the right. ③ If leading…
